purpose: Measurement feasibility only; no source benefit estimate or fit
case_selection: For Cologne native P100 and Jinan original-demand native B100: lexicographic numeric(seed,checkpoint,group_id), earliest group with preaction total_q>0 and a nonPP switch candidate. No outcome used to select group or action.
candidate_selection: First stored candidate with index != PP and switch_indicator>0
validity_gate: Four complete native branches; same-state PP/candidate; retained candidate features and original450cost reproduce; no teleport; movement event accounting has no unassigned crossings or double counts; per-movement labels distinguish measured zero from unresolved/missing. No performance gate in this measurement pilot.
limits: Reused states and four trajectories only establish measurement feasibility; zero learning or transfer claims.
